# Embryo Cryopreservation — Authorization Guide

_CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements_

(backHref: /embryo-cryo)

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 89258 | Cryopreservation; embryo(s) | Embryo freeze |
| 89352 | Thawing of cryopreserved; oocyte(s) | Oocyte thaw |
| 89353 | Thawing of cryopreserved; embryo(s) | Embryo thaw |
| 89344 | Storage, per year; embryo(s) | Annual storage |
| 89346 | Storage, per year; oocyte(s) | Oocyte storage |
| 58974 | Embryo transfer, intrauterine (FET) | FET procedure |
| 89253 | Assisted embryo hatching, microtechnique | Assisted hatching |
| 76830 | Ultrasound, transvaginal (FET monitoring) | Monitoring US |
| 82670 | Estradiol (FET monitoring) | Estradiol level |
| 84144 | Progesterone (luteal phase support monitoring) | Progesterone level |

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Z31.83 | Encounter for assisted reproductive fertility procedure cycle |
| Z31.62 | Encounter for fertility preservation procedure |
| N97.9 | Female infertility, unspecified |
| Z79.899 | Other long-term (current) drug therapy (chemotherapy — oncofertility) |
| N70.11 | Chronic salpingitis (tubal factor) |
| N46.01 | Organic azoospermia (male factor requiring ICSI + embryo cryo) |

## Coverage Landscape

### Common Denial Reasons

- Annual storage fees (89344) almost universally excluded
- Embryo cryopreservation denied as "not medically necessary" (when bundled with IVF)
- FET cycle denied separately from IVF authorization
- Oncofertility embryo cryo denied if oncology diagnosis not linked

### Strongest Coverage Arguments

- Oncofertility: ASCO 2018 — embryo cryopreservation is standard of care before gonadotoxic therapy
- Freeze-all for OHSS prevention: medically necessary to prevent life-threatening OHSS
- CPT 89258 (embryo freeze) is a distinct service from IVF — not bundled per AMA CPT
- FET (58974) is a separate procedure requiring separate authorization in many plans
- Some state mandates include FET cycles as part of IVF coverage

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation

- IVF authorization (embryo cryopreservation is typically part of IVF cycle authorization)
- For oncofertility: oncology treatment plan with gonadotoxic therapy documentation
- For freeze-all/OHSS: documentation of OHSS risk factors (estradiol level, follicle count)
- For FET: separate authorization may be required — confirm with payer
- Letter of medical necessity from REI specialist
- Note: annual storage fees (89344) are self-pay at most institutions
